items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee, Toots Thielemans, identifies 'Jean-Baptiste Frédéric Isidor' as his own birth name ('I was born in Belgium. Jean-Baptiste Frédéric Isidor. Four first names. And then Thielemans.').

ctx.x: And in Belgium… I was born in Belgium. Jean-Baptiste Frédéric Isidor. Four first names. And then Thielemans.
